role: Google Gemini AIProvider: model catalog, request body types, SSE streaming of generateContent with function calling (a reply is complete only after a candidate's finishReason; MAX_TOKENS ends with '…', safety stops are blocked replies, a malformed function call or event throws), thought-signature round-trip and its non-2xx mapping (400 API_KEY_INVALID is an auth failure) through ProviderHTTP.statusFailure.
types: GeminiProvider.RequestBody: struct — Encodable generateContent body (systemInstruction, contents, tools)
extension GeminiProvider.RequestBody.FunctionDeclaration — CodingKeys + custom encode that omits empty parameters
GeminiProvider.StreamState: struct — per-request SSE state (tool-use counter, last usage, finished)
state: mem:GeminiProvider.models (static catalog: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash default, gemini-3.1-pro-preview)
toplevel: Static model catalog with prices/context windows pinned by ProviderModelCatalogTests; id = .gemini; RequestBody nested Encodable structs use synthesized encoding except FunctionDeclaration (custom encode in an extension at the file end). Key handling and the catalog accessor come from KeyedCloudProvider. The URL session, request building, opening the stream, cache-marker split, <live_state> envelope, error-body draining and status mapping are ProviderHTTP's.

units.does: AIProvider.send witness: returns ProviderStream.make wrapping GeminiProvider.stream with all inputs, so failures are normalised to AIProviderError and the request task is cancelled when the consumer stops.
units.entry: AIProvider protocol witness called by the assistant tool loop (AssistantViewModel+Tools) via dyn:AIProvider.send.

Memberwise init producing a functionCall part with optional thoughtSignature echo.
Memberwise init producing a functionResponse part.

Maps chat turns to Gemini contents (user→"user", everything else→"model"), appending the live_state block to the text of the last user turn; if there is no user turn and the block is non-empty it inserts a synthetic user turn at index 0; then appends a model/user content pair per non-empty tool round.

branches.effect: role "user"; otherwise "model" (assistant and any other role become model).

branches.cond: splice (this is the last user turn and liveStateBlock non-empty)
branches.effect: text = turn.text + liveStateBlock; otherwise turn.text unchanged.

branches.cond: no user message exists and liveStateBlock non-empty
branches.effect: inserts a standalone user content holding only the live-state block at position 0; otherwise nothing.

branches.cond: for each tool round, skipping empty rounds
branches.effect: appends toolRoundContents(round) (model call turn + user response turn); empty rounds contribute nothing.

units.does: Builds one tool round as a model content of functionCall parts (args parsed from inputJSON, thought signature recovered from the tool-use id) followed by a user content of functionResponse parts whose response is {"result": <parsed resultJSON>}, or {"result": "<the text>"} when the result is not JSON (a plain-text resolver error reaches the model as written).

branches.cond: inputJSON parses to a JSON object (try? ... as? [String:Any])
branches.effect: uses parsed dictionary; ?? fallback [:] when parse fails or the JSON is not an object — the call is echoed with empty args.
uses parsed value; ?? the raw resultJSON string otherwise

units.does: Builds the synthetic tool-use id "gemini_call_<counter>", appending "#sig:<thoughtSignature>" when a non-empty signature exists.

branches.effect: returns base id only; otherwise base + "#sig:" + signature.

units.does: Recovers the thought signature from a synthetic tool-use id: the substring after the first "#sig:".

branches.effect: returns the text after it; otherwise nil (no signature echoed).

units.does: Builds https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/<apiID>:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse.

branches.effect: returns it; otherwise throws AIProviderError.invalidResponse("bad endpoint").

units.does: Reads the Gemini key from Keychain, splits the system prompt at the cache marker (ProviderHTTP.splitOnCacheMarker: stable half → systemInstruction, variable half + contextRendered → ProviderHTTP.liveStateEnvelope on the last user turn), builds tool declarations, builds the request (makeRequest), opens the stream through ProviderHTTP.openStream (connect failure logged, non-2xx thrown as statusFailure's error), then consumes the SSE body's lines (consumeSSE yields .done only after a finishReason and throws for a cut, malformed, blocked or failed reply).

branches.effect: throws statusFailure of the status and body; otherwise streams the body.

units.does: Maps ToolSpecs to one Gemini Tool of functionDeclarations, omitting parameters for tools with an empty properties map (Gemini rejects empty OBJECT schemas).

branches.effect: returns nil so the tools key is omitted; otherwise one Tool.
parameters nil (omitted in JSON); otherwise the schema.

units.does: Builds the POST URLRequest with Content-Type JSON, Accept text/event-stream, x-goog-api-key header and a sortedKeys JSON body.

Reads a reply's SSE line sequence (the URL session's lines, or a test's) through readChunks, which parses each non-empty data: payload (ProviderHTTP.eventObject; a payload that is not a JSON object throws) and hands it to handleChunk (which throws on an error object, a blocked prompt or a failing finish reason). When reading throws, it yields one .usage from the last usageMetadata seen and rethrows. After the stream it yields one .usage from the last usageMetadata; then a cancelled task throws CancellationError, so Stop reads as cancellation; then, when no candidate carried a finishReason, the stream was cut and it throws URLError(.networkConnectionLost) (a fallbackable .network via ProviderStream); otherwise it yields .done.

branches.cond: readChunks threw (reading, parsing or a chunk)
task cancelled when the sequence ended

units.does: Reads the line sequence as server-sent events (SSEEvents, which checks task cancellation per line and skips everything but non-empty data: payloads): each payload is parsed by ProviderHTTP.eventObject and handled by handleChunk with the shared state. Throws what reading, cancellation, parsing or a chunk throws.

branches.effect: loop; sequence, parse and chunk errors propagate.

units.does: One parsed chunk: first the chunk's usageMetadata replaces the held one (so a chunk that throws still counts); then an {"error":...} object (ProviderHTTP.streamFailure, the overloaded modelUnavailable for a 5xx code) or a blocked prompt (blockedPrompt) throws; a finish reason that ends the reply as a failure (stopFailure: safety stops, malformed function call) throws before the chunk's parts are shown; otherwise each content part becomes a text delta or a synthesized tool use (yieldPart), a MAX_TOKENS stop logs and yields a '…' text delta, and any finish reason marks the reply finished.

branches.effect: replaces lastUsage; ?? keeps the previous one

units.does: Returns candidates[0].finishReason, or nil while the reply is still coming.

Maps a finish reason to the error it ends the reply with: SAFETY, RECITATION, BLOCKLIST, PROHIBITED_CONTENT and SPII to AIProviderError.blockedReply(provider: .gemini, reason:) (not fallbackable), MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL to .invalidResponse('Gemini sent a malformed function call'); nil for STOP, MAX_TOKENS and any other reason.

For a chunk with no candidates whose promptFeedback carries a blockReason, returns .blockedReply(provider: .gemini, reason: <reason>) — Gemini's safety system refused the request, which is shown and never sent on to another provider; nil for any other chunk.
Returns candidates[0].content.parts as dictionaries, or [] when any level is missing.

branches.cond: candidates/content/parts all present with expected types

units.does: Turns one Gemini part into a stream event: non-empty text → .textDelta; else a functionCall with name → increments counter and yields .toolUse with synthesized id (with thought signature) and sortedKeys args JSON.

branches.effect: yields .textDelta and returns (a functionCall in the same part would be ignored).

branches.cond: part has functionCall with a String name

units.does: Converts Gemini usageMetadata to .usage: input = promptTokenCount − cachedContentTokenCount (floored at 0), output = candidatesTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount (thinking tokens are billed as output), cached = cachedContentTokenCount, cacheCreation 0; emits nothing when all are zero.

branches.cond: input, output and cached all zero

units.does: The error a non-2xx Gemini reply becomes: ProviderHTTP.statusFailure with an override that turns a 400 whose body contains API_KEY_INVALID (Gemini's bad-key answer) into .authFailed; a credit failure is .outOfCredit(.gemini) before that, and everything else maps through the shared statusError path (envelope message or 300 characters of the body).

branches.cond: status 400 and the redacted body contains API_KEY_INVALID

units.does: Encodes name, description and parameters only when non-nil, so no-argument tools carry no parameters key.
